prompt: A huge windowless data centre in green English fields at dusk, its cooling fans turning, security lights bright on its white walls: right up against its perimeter fence a camp of tents and parked cars, cooking fires, people sitting with their backs to the fence where it is warm from the exhaust vents. Winter dusk in a near-future Britain, cold blue-grey light, the only warm colour the small orange fires of braziers and camping stoves; photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, deep shadows that stay dark, no lens flare, no bloom, no teal-orange grade. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no signs, banners, logos, number plates or screen text. No children.
